2609.06126.title: CWF: A Collaborative Writing Framework for Personalized and Reliable Popular Science Writing
2609.06126.paper_summary: We introduce Personalized and Reliable Popular Science Writing, a novel task that requires adapting scientific explanations to audiences with different cognitive levels while preserving factual accuracy. However, improving personalization often introduces simplifications that increase the risk of hallucination and factual distortion. To address these challenges, we first construct a dataset of 39,134 entries and a reader-centric Personalized Science Communication Benchmark (PSCB) that jointly evaluates audience adaptation and factual accuracy. To reduce data and computational requirements while improving generalization across domains and audiences, we introduce DA-MoE, which explicitly decouples audience adaptation from domain knowledge through separate modeling. To enable robust verification and revision in evidence-scarce scenarios, a multi-agent fact-checking mechanism that augments limited evidence with role-specific agent debate and propagates confidence over a graph is proposed. Experiments on PSCB show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our code is open-sourced at https://github.com/DPInnovationWorks/CWF.
2609.06126.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹個性化和可靠的科普寫作，這是一項新穎的任務，要求將科學解釋調整為不同認知水平的受眾，同時保持事實準確性。<lb/>然而，改善個性化往往會引入簡化，增加幻覺和事實扭曲的風險。<lb/>為了解決這些挑戰，我們首先構建了一個包含39,134條目和以讀者為中心的個性化科學傳播基準（PSCB），該基準共同評估受眾適應性和事實準確性。<lb/>為了減少數據和計算需求，同時提高跨領域和受眾的泛化能力，我們引入了DA-MoE，它通過單獨建模明確地將受眾適應性與領域知識解耦。<lb/>為了在證據稀缺的情況下實現穩健的驗證和修訂，提出了一種多代理事實檢查機制，該機制通過角色特定的代理辯論增強有限的證據並在圖上傳播信心。<lb/>在PSCB上的實驗顯示，我們的方法達到了最先進的性能。<lb/>我們的代碼已在 https://github.com/DPInnovationWorks/CWF 開源。
